title: Noor and the Choir
author: Vesper Quintana
blurb: Tamsin Thackeray, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
